## What to build

Keep package-generated dtplyr contextual-share membership independent of an unrelated `%in%` root binding, retaining ADR 0010/0017 share values and caller expression lookup.

## Reproduction

Confirmed independently on main `1b3e8df656f0523ef21f85298f6db5c865e1e12a`, macOS arm64, R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1, dtplyr 1.3.3, data.table 1.18.6.1, rlang 1.3.0. The bounded reproduction asserted the observed failures and controls and exited 0; no relevant guards were skipped.

```r
pkgload::load_all()
root <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
root$source <- data.frame(g = c("b", "a", NA_character_), x = 1:3)
input <- evalq(dtplyr::lazy_dt(source), root)
query <- summarize_with_margins(input, total = sum(x),
  p = share_of_total(total), .grouping = rollup(g), .sort = "last")
dplyr::collect(query) # a/b/NA/Total; p = 2/6, 1/6, 3/6, 1
root$`%in%` <- function(...) stop("caller membership helper ran")
dplyr::collect(query) # Error: caller membership helper ran
dplyr::collect(input) # original input; no callback
rm(list = "%in%", envir = root)
dplyr::collect(query) # expected result restored
```

Parent shares reproduce the same failure. Source bytes remain unchanged. A root binding present before construction also fails at collection. Construction remains lazy.

## Cause and scope

`apply_share_ratios()` in `R/share.R` generates an unqualified `%in%` test for own-denominator Grouping set identifiers. Audit other generated share membership expressions too. This differs from the final ordering expressions repaired by #1176/#1197, Margin-label helpers (#1143), nesting display extraction (#1089), and special-measure lexical alias rewriting (#1033/#1186). Preserve caller-written helper lookup, other backend translations, source immutability and lazy boundaries.

## Duplicate search

All-state issue/PR queries: `share "%in%"`, `share helper binding`, `share membership caller`, `dtplyr share lexical`, `dtplyr share caller`, `dtplyr membership`; also all-state `dtplyr` lists filtered for caller/helper/lexical/binding/membership. Full bodies/comments of #1176, #1143, #1089, #1033 and #1186 and the #1197 record were examined. No duplicate or matching repair found.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Parent/Total ratios and own-denominator ones remain correct under preexisting and late root `%in%` bindings.
- [ ] Package-generated membership never invokes those callbacks; cover counting and raising callbacks and relevant denominator-selection paths.
- [ ] Preserve ordinary caller expression lookup, source bytes, visible names, local/native controls and lazy construction.
- [ ] Add public-seam tests under the optional-backend policy.

## Blocked by

None. Separate defect found during bounded checking for PR #1192; that PR does not repair it.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** bug
**Summary:** Isolate package-generated contextual-share membership from dtplyr root `%in%` bindings while retaining ordinary caller lookup.

**Current behavior:** Reproduced on current main `82d0f300711997a16a5fd575a3ba43fe47074751`: Total shares collect correctly until a late root `%in%` binding raises `caller membership helper ran`. Collecting the original input remains correct. The share calculation generates unqualified membership for own-denominator occurrences and for selecting among successive Parent denominators. No matching repair was found in the share calculation or existing dtplyr helper-isolation tests; no `.out-of-scope` directory exists.

**Desired behavior:** Parent/Total shares obey ADR 0010/0017 regardless of preexisting or late unrelated root membership bindings. Package expressions use their intended membership operation; caller-written expressions retain their own lexical bindings.

**Key interfaces:** `summarize_with_margins()` with `share_of_parent()`/`share_of_total()`, observed through `dplyr::collect()` on dtplyr inputs. No public signature changes.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] Preexisting and late counting/raising `%in%` callbacks are never invoked by package membership; own-denominator shares remain one.
- [ ] Multi-dimension Parent shares select the right denominator at every level, including fixed partitions and missing keys. Total shares remain correct.
- [ ] Caller-written membership still uses caller lookup; source bytes and public names remain intact; construction performs no data evaluation.
- [ ] Public-seam regressions comply with the single-optional-backend policy; local and native SQL controls remain correct.

**Out of scope:** Changes to other helper lookup, share eligibility, backend dispatch, public arguments, and lazy execution policy.

**Implementation/testing decision:** The maintainer delegated TDD boundary selection. Use the public summary-to-collection seam, adding one failing behavior slice before each fix. Review-ready requires `full` because package code and tests change.
Implemented in #1208. The pull request contains the pinned verification and independent Standards/Spec review records.

title: [P2] Isolate dtplyr contextual-share membership from caller bindings
